name: govannon
description: Govannon (Fall from Heaven), the Luchuirp sage hero: a bald old man with a white fringe of hair and a full white beard, deep-blue wizard robes trimmed in white and silver with white star motifs over a pale-blue under-robe, a silver belt clasp, brown boots, a tall silver staff topped with a glowing blue four-pointed star in his RIGHT hand, and an open brown spellbook with blue sparkles in his LEFT hand
hands: the star-topped staff stays in his right hand on the screen-left side, held upright; his left hand on the screen-right side holds the open spellbook in front of him

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the bald head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, the white beard flying, torso jolts back, both arms jerk (the staff hand knocked down to hip height on the left, the star-topped staff tipping in to slant up behind his shoulder; the spellbook hand jerked in against the hip, still clutching the open spellbook)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent under the blue robe, the staff hand still low on the left with the star-topped staff slanting behind him, the open spellbook still clutched at the hip

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up with the star-topped staff, the spellbook drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward under the robe, torso slumps forward, the bald head droops, the staff lowering, its blue star dimming
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the star-topped end of the staff resting on the ground at the lower-right, the spellbook arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the staff slips out of his hand, the spellbook falls, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the star-topped staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the open spellbook lies beside him, the blue robe spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the robe settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the white beard on his chest, the staff with its dimmed star and the spellbook on the ground beside him
